content.name: Second Wind
entries: You have a limited well of stamina that you can draw on to protect yourself from harm. On your turn, you can use a bonus action to regain hit points equal to {@dice 1d10} + your fighter level.
Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

content.name: Second Wind
entries: You have a limited well of physical and mental stamina that you can draw on. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}, you can use it to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} equal to {@dice 1d10} plus your Fighter level.
You can use this feature twice. You regain one expended use when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|SRD52}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}.
When you reach certain Fighter levels, you gain more uses of this feature, as shown in the Second Wind column of the Fighter Features table.
